subject: Mobile Development
title: Indie Developers vs. Big Studios
description: A quick, practical guide to Indie Developers vs. Big Studios.

hook.text: Flappy Bird was made by one developer in a few days. It earned $50,000 per day in ad revenue.

buildup.text: Indie developers can still create hits with small teams and original ideas.

discovery.text: But big studios dominate the charts with massive marketing budgets and data-driven optimization.

twist.text: The top mobile game companies spend more on user acquisition than on building the game itself.

climax.text: Indie success stories still happen, but the odds grow longer as the market matures.

punchline.text: One person can still win, but the house has the edge.

quiz.question: What do top mobile game companies spend the most on?
